name: project-atlas

scripts.dev: node scripts/start.cjs --doctor --dev && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && node scripts/start.cjs --dev"
scripts.test: node tests/core.test.cjs && node tests/security.test.cjs && node tests/main.test.cjs && node tests/requirements.test.cjs && node tests/packaging.test.cjs && node tests/updates.test.cjs && node tests/technologies.test.cjs && node tests/github.test.cjs && node tests/health.test.cjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src electron scripts tests .github *.cjs *.json *.ts *.md index.html
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run icons && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --publish never

description: A local workspace for consulting projects, monitoring, and vulnerability awareness.
